newsitem.title: USA: Vallen Corp units awarded Pemex contract.
newsitem.headline: Vallen Corp units awarded Pemex contract.

text.p: Vallen Corp said on Tuesday that a group consisting of a Mexican affiliate and two Vallen units was awarded a contract worth about $7.5 million to implement a workplace safety and health program for Mexico's state-owned oil company Pemex.
The group awarded the contract consists of Proveedora de Seguridad Industrial del Golfo, SA, 50 percent owned by Vallen, and the companys' Vallen Knowledge Systems and ValTech Systems Inc.

Vallen said it would be working closely with Pemex personnel "to create a superior safety culture" in locations throughout Mexico. The project, which applies to Pemex's Exploration and Production operations, will be coordinated by Proveedora within Mexico, Vallen said in a statement.
